name: Camera & Photo
when_to_use: Screenshots and freeze-frames, snapshot cards pinned one per beat, photo reveals, before/after stills, white-flash transitions (a CapCut course pairs shutters with transitions), punch-ins faking a camera zoom (lens servo).

sounds.name: SLR Burst Shutter 03
sounds.desc: A 1.8-second SLR burst of rapid shutters; use it under a quick photo montage or a burst of freeze-frames.

sounds.name: Autofocus Motor 01
sounds.desc: An 11-second take of a DSLR lens autofocus motor buzzing and hunting; cut a short whirr under a punch-in to fake a camera zoom.

sounds.name: Instamatic Film Wind 01
sounds.desc: A second, shorter Instamatic film-wind ratchet; rotate it with the others after shutter clicks in a run of snapshot cards.

sounds.name: Instamatic Film Wind 02
sounds.desc: A bright, slightly longer Instamatic film-wind ratchet; good for a retro snapshot moment or a photo being 'advanced' to the next frame.

sounds.name: Instamatic Shutter 01
sounds.desc: A light, tight plastic shutter click from an Instamatic camera; use it on a casual snapshot or a freeze-frame in a playful photo sequence.

sounds.name: Instamatic Shutter 02
sounds.desc: A second tight, plasticky Instamatic shutter click; rotate it with the first for multiple snapshot beats.

sounds.name: Paparazzi Shutters 01
sounds.desc: A stereo flurry of several cameras firing like paparazzi on a red carpet; use it for 'everyone is talking about this' or fame and hype moments.

sounds.name: Paparazzi Shutters 02
sounds.desc: A second, shorter stereo paparazzi flurry of overlapping camera shutters; good under a press or headline-wall montage.

sounds.name: SLR Shutter Single 02
sounds.desc: A second single SLR shutter trigger; rotate it with the first when you have several screenshots or freeze-frames in a row.

sounds.name: Vintage Camera Shutter 01
sounds.desc: An old mechanical camera shutter firing with a metallic ring in the tail; use it for vintage photo reveals or before/after stills.

sounds.name: Digital Camera Trigger 01
sounds.desc: A bright, tonal camera trigger dominated by a high electronic ring (likely a compact camera's focus beep or shutter tone); use it for a digital snapshot or a focus-lock beat.

sounds.name: Flash Powder Poof 01
sounds.desc: A quick old-time flash-powder ignition poof with a short burst tail; use it on a white-flash transition or a vintage photo reveal.

sounds.name: SLR Burst Shutter 01
sounds.desc: A tight one-second SLR burst of rapid shutters; use it for a quick 'snap snap snap' freeze-frame beat.

sounds.name: SLR Burst Shutter 02
sounds.desc: A 1.5-second SLR burst of rapid shutters; good for a run of snapshot cards pinning up one after another.

sounds.name: Instamatic Film Wind 03
sounds.desc: A bright plastic ratchet as an Instamatic camera's film is wound on; use it after a shutter on snapshot cards or a retro photo beat.

sounds.name: Instamatic Film Wind 04
sounds.desc: A louder, bright Instamatic film-wind ratchet; use it to punctuate the next snapshot card sliding into place.

sounds.name: SLR Burst Shutter 04
sounds.desc: An 8-second run of SLR burst-mode shutters firing rapidly; cut a length to match a rapid-fire run of snapshot cards or a photo montage.

sounds.name: SLR Shutter Single 01
sounds.desc: A single SLR shutter trigger with mirror slap; place it on a screenshot, freeze-frame or snapshot card landing.

sounds.name: Camera Shutter Double 01
sounds.desc: Two loud camera shutter triggers back to back; good for a pair of snapshot cards landing or a quick double freeze-frame.

sounds.name: Camera Shutter Wind 01
sounds.desc: A quiet camera sequence with mechanism handling building to a shutter about 3.6 s in; trim it to the shutter for photo or screenshot moments.

sounds.name: Flash Powder Poof 02
sounds.desc: A darker, boomier flash-powder whoomph with sub weight; use it under a white-flash cut or a soft reveal hit.
